channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block H
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block H (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: Block H's record and map shape now say: the base building maximum is 60 ft on the Mission Rock Street side and 40 ft on the Terry A. Francois Boulevard side (not 40 ft only); 'across from Mission Bay South' was removed because the Design Controls do not say it; the flex designation is cited to the Design Controls, not the 2012 proposal; 'unbuilt' is dated to the Port's June 2026 update; the EIR's illustrative phasing is no longer said to be 'superseded by the DDA phasing'; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the Port Commission actions of 2018, 2023 and 2025 cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025)

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block H: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023)
item.description: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022)
item.description: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Development Agreement and DDA take effect; DA term 30 years, project planned in up to four phases (Aug 15, 2018)
